Purpose by Design Architects (PXD) is a full-service architectural practice dedicated to thoughtful, collaborative, and purpose-driven work that strengthens communities, advances sustainable design, and makes a lasting positive impact on our city and future generations.
We are seeking an Architect Level III / Project Manager with 8+ years of experience in the design, execution, and management of both new construction and renovation projects. The ideal candidate has experience in NYC multifamily affordable housing, along with strong familiarity with local zoning, building codes, and regulatory processes.
This role offers the opportunity to work on projects from concept through construction, serving as a primary point of contact for clients, consultants, and project teams in close coordination with the Principals. As a growing small firm, we value initiative, design input, and collaborative problem-solving, and we offer meaningful opportunities to shape both your career path and the future of the practice.
What We Offer
Candidates must reside in the New York City area. Salary range $95,000 - $110,000 annually, commensurate with experience.
Interested candidates should send resume, 3–5 work samples, and at least two references to [email protected].
